$comment: Request/response JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) for supabase.postman_collection.json, rendered into its items' descriptions and SUPABASE_SCHEMAS.md (linked from SUPABASE.md). Edit here, then: uv run --no-sync python scripts/api_schemas.py render supabase. An OPEN subset (additionalProperties: true) of the upstream services behind the Envoy gateway, each entry's `$comment` naming its source and the image tag pinned in docker-compose.supabase.yml; the `hello` function is this repo's code, so its body is closed. Table rows: shapes only, never values. No request bodies (every call is a GET). Checked by unit-tests/apidocs only (tier 1); an image-tag bump re-checks them (ai/supabase/CLAUDE.md).

GET /auth/v1/health.$comment: GoTrue internal/api/api.go HealthCheck at the v2.196.0 tag; image supabase/gotrue:v2.196.0.

description.const: GoTrue is a user registration and authentication API

GET /rest/v1/.$comment: PostgREST's root: its OpenAPI 2.0 (Swagger) description of the exposed schemas; image postgrest/postgrest:v14.17.
GET /rest/v1/.description: The tables and views of SUPABASE_PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS, as the `apikey`'s role sees them (nearly empty here: this repo creates no application tables).

definitions.description: One per table / view: its columns

GET /rest/v1/:table.$comment: PostgREST's read of a table or view; image postgrest/postgrest:v14.17.
GET /rest/v1/:table.description: One object per row, the columns `select` names (`*`: all); at most SUPABASE_PGRST_DB_MAX_ROWS (1000) whatever `limit` says. An empty array where rows exist is row-level security filtering the role.

GET /storage/v1/status.$comment: storage-api src/app.ts (`/status`) at the v1.74.0 tag; image supabase/storage-api:v1.74.0.

GET /functions/v1/hello.$comment: This repo's edge function (ai/supabase/volumes/functions/hello/index.ts) behind the vendored router (volumes/functions/main/index.ts); image supabase/edge-runtime:v1.76.2.
GET /functions/v1/hello.description: Unauthenticated while SUPABASE_FUNCTIONS_VERIFY_JWT is false (this deployment's default).

401.description: only with SUPABASE_FUNCTIONS_VERIFY_JWT=true: no, or a bad, Bearer token (the same code in the `sb-error-code` header)

GET /realtime/v1/api/tenants/realtime-de.$comment: Realtime lib/realtime_web/controllers/tenant_controller.ex health and lib/realtime/tenants.ex health_check at the v2.134.10 tag; image supabase/realtime:v2.134.10.
GET /realtime/v1/api/tenants/realtime-de.description: `healthy: false, db_connected: false` after a SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET rotation is the one-shot-secret trap (SUPABASE.md § Secrets that are one-shot). 404 for an unknown tenant.

GET /.$comment: Envoy basic auth in front of Studio; images envoyproxy/envoy:v1.39.1, supabase/studio:2026.09.07-sha-7996410.
